assessment_md:
**Right now:** No position — the signal is flat (`signal 0`), with BTC around $63.8k. Nothing is at risk this moment.

**The numbers:** The full ledger shows 12 resolved trades averaging **-10.0 bps** net (total -120 bps), win rate 25%. The rolling window of 11 bets is milder at **-1.9 bps net** (gross +1.1 bps, minus 3.0 bps cost), win rate ~45%. So both samples are negative, but the headline -10 bps average is badly skewed by outliers: a single -58 bps loss (2026-07-31) and two other ~-18 to -23 bps trades account for most of the damage. Strip those and the rest cluster near zero, as expected for a marginal signal.

**What this does and doesn't tell us:** Recall the validated edge is only ~4 bps gross versus a ~3.9 bps breakeven — this was always expected to be roughly break-even-to-slightly-negative after real costs. With just **12 trades**, this is far too thin to conclude anything; a couple of tail moves dominate the P&L. This is noise-level data, not evidence of a structural break.

**Vs last time:** Essentially unchanged — one more trade added, still flat, still tiny sample. No new degradation signal.

**Bottom line:** Performance is negative but within what you'd expect from a marginal, cost-sensitive strategy on a handful of trades. Too thin to judge, no action warranted. Keep accumulating trades before drawing conclusions; watch whether losses broaden beyond a few outliers. No profit is implied or guaranteed here.
